header.name: Galaxy Sun V10
header.description: Galaxy Sun, increment 10: all eight planets and Halley's Comet at the true drift speed (230 km/s, about 5,820 in per year on the 1 AU = 120 in scale), with their trails on from the start. Each trail is a row of loops, far apart. The galactic plane starts with its eye shut.

object.description: the Sun, and everything that moves with it (the drift)
